_about: Layout findings we accept, each with why. Fields are globs: row, set, shot, kind, node, detail.

known.why: Steam serves achievement icons at 64 px; we show them as they are and never upscale or re-fetch them. Drawn ~64 px, so a 4K TV (2.7x) shows them soft.

The launch splash fills the screen with the game's hero art, whose largest published size is 1920 px wide (Steam, SteamGridDB); a 4K screen can only show it soft. The splash is on screen about a second.

The Discover hero is the deal's store image at the size the store offers (Steam header images are 460x215; the screenshot sets use a 360 px one). We show it as it is: nothing bigger is published for most deals, and fetching another image would add a request per deal. Soft only on a 4K TV.
The launch splash's game logo is the logo art from SteamGridDB / Steam, at most 900 px wide; on a 4K TV (2.7x) it is drawn 60 % sharp for the second the splash shows. Nothing bigger is published.
